shots.name: measure_seal
shots.js: t.ui.help(false); await t.ui.settings.open('view'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const r=(e)=>{const b=e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(b.left),Math.round(b.top),Math.round(b.width),Math.round(b.height)]}; const s=document.querySelector('.qs-tab-seal'); const cs=getComputedStyle(s); const k=document.querySelector('.qs-cost-k'); return { tab: r(s.parentElement), seal: r(s), kids: [...s.children].map(r), fs: cs.fontSize, lh: cs.lineHeight, disp: cs.display, ff: cs.fontFamily.slice(0,30), kid0: getComputedStyle(s.children[0]).display, cost: r(k), dial: [...document.getElementById('dial').children].map(r), dialSelf: getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('dial')).display };
